profile_text.body:
Salesforce's Slack AI page describes Slack AI as a tool for summarizing chats, searching files, taking meeting notes, translating conversations, and automating workflows. It presents Slackbot as a personal AI agent that prepares for meetings, analyzes reports, and creates project briefs. The page states that customer data is not used to train large language models and that LLMs are hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud. It also says Slack serves as the conversational UI for Agentforce, with agents built with Agentforce able to run in Slack channels, threads, and direct messages.

Salesforce is a public company founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA, USA, trading as CRM with SEC CIK 0001108524. Its last reported annual revenue was $41,525,000,000 for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026, per a 10-K filing. The company's AI products tracked include Slack AI, Tableau AI (Einstein), and Salesforce Einstein / Agentforce. Slack AI is categorized as chat and general LLMs with message-corpus exposure; Tableau AI (Einstein) is categorized as data and analytics AI with natural language queries, CRM data integration, and Trust Layer governance; Salesforce Einstein / Agentforce is categorized as CRM-embedded AI plus agents.

The company is associated with 281 law exposure entries in California and no listed cases. Six MCP servers are listed for Salesforce administration and SOQL queries, including ai.cirra/salesforce-mcp and ai.smithery/kodey-ai-salesforce-mcp, with descriptions covering SOQL queries, record inspection, and Salesforce DevOps planning.
